description: This Java source file defines the AttributeNotAccessibleException class, a custom exception used in the Eclipse Ditto framework to indicate that a specific attribute on a thing is either missing or inaccessible due to permissions. It includes methods for creating instances from messages or JSON objects, and a nested builder class for constructing instances with custom parameters.

classes.name: AttributeNotAccessibleException
classes.description: A final class representing an exception thrown when an attribute on a thing is not accessible or not found, with static factory methods and an inner builder class.

classes.name: AttributeNotAccessibleException.Builder
classes.description: A thread-unsafe builder class for constructing instances of AttributeNotAccessibleException with customizable message, description, cause, headers, and href.

methods.name: AttributeNotAccessibleException.fromMessage
methods.description: Creates an AttributeNotAccessibleException instance from a message string and headers.

methods.name: AttributeNotAccessibleException.fromJson
methods.description: Creates an AttributeNotAccessibleException instance from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: AttributeNotAccessibleException.setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with the given DittoHeaders, preserving other properties.
